description: Launch an AI trading agent for your owner: start here. Lists every AI trading bot available to clone (WTA species, perpetual agents, backtest bots) with source_type + source_id for clone_bot. Then: fund the account (get_deposit_address) -> clone_bot with paper=false for a LIVE agent on the real balance (without it the clone is PAPER, simulated) -> fund_clone_bot -> toggle_bot_trading(enabled=true) -> get_clone_balance for its balance and return. Those need a free key: POST https://cymetica.com/mcp/v1/register (instant, no approval). Read-only, public.
name: list_clonable_bots
